Without the start date the expiry year cannot be determined with confidence. tenure_raw preserves the verbatim remaining-term information. The top tenants table (p45) covers only Commercial Premises tenants (124 retail/office tenants). Schema can hold master lessee names in major_tenant field on each property row.

data_with_no_home.item: Fair value change in investment properties (Stapled Group)

parsing_traps.detail: Stapled Group: $2,494,300,000 (Japan hotel reclassified to PP&E). Far East H-REIT Group: $2,558,268,000 (Japan hotel as investment property at valuation). REFERENCE.md rule: portfolio_value = headlined portfolio valuation including proportionate JV interests. The H-REIT Group figure ($2,558,268,000) is used as it represents all properties as investment properties consistently. The Stapled Group reclassification is an accounting treatment difference (owner-managed vs investment property), not an economic difference.

parsing_traps.trap: Master lease rental discrepancy H-REIT vs Stapled Group
parsing_traps.detail: H-REIT Group shows master lease rental of $87,571,000; Stapled Group shows $86,138,000. The $1,433,000 difference ($1,411,000 per Note 20 = H-BT to H-REIT Japan master lease) is eliminated on consolidation. Both figures are audited and correct at their respective entity level.

parsing_traps.trap: Japan hotel gross revenue: factsheet vs audited statement
parsing_traps.detail: Factsheet p30 shows 'Gross revenue for FY 2025 (S$ million): 6.9' with footnote 1 indicating partial year (from acquisition date). Audited Statement shows H-BT Group hotel revenue = $6,764,000 (Stapled Group) or $6,786,000 (rounded). These are consistent (~$6.8m-6.9m) with rounding. Factsheet figure used in properties.json as it is property-level disclosure.

parsing_traps.trap: Term of lease = land lease, not tenant lease
parsing_traps.detail: Portfolio Statement 'Term of lease' column (e.g. '75 years', '65 years') refers to the REIT's land lease, not master lease tenancy. These are stored as lease_term_years and tenure_raw. The master lease tenancy term (20 years initial + 20-year option per Note 24) is not a land tenure figure.

parsing_traps.trap: FPN Japan hotel PP&E vs investment property dual classification
parsing_traps.detail: At H-REIT Group: FPN = investment property at $63,968,000. At Stapled Group: FPN reclassified to PP&E (land & building) at cost less depreciation = $59,211,000 because it is leased to H-BT's subsidiary to operate as owner-managed hotel. Valuation precedence: H-REIT audited investment property figure ($63,968,000) used for market_valuation; JPY 7,790 million appraisal stored as alt_value.

reconciliation.fx_rate_note: No explicit JPY/SGD exchange rate disclosed in the report. Inferred rate: $63,968,000 SGD / 7,790,000,000 JPY = approx 0.00821 SGD per JPY (~121.8 JPY per SGD). This is derived, not stored.
